title: Pointwise completeness transport in constant coordinates
statement: For one object K of sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X, the object H(K) is locally derived complete for the lifted uniformizer ideal on the published small site.

source.place: Tag 099I and proetale.tex Tag 099M, restriction-derived-complete equivalence

proof.text: Identify the positive coefficient quotient tower with the powers of the uniformizer ideal and transport the Roos-unit triangle through the exact small-site module equivalence. The resulting unit criterion is exactly the local IsComplete predicate for H(K), including zero and empty-site cases.

from.place: first conjunct, specialized to one input

lean.statement:
theorem integralConstantCompleteTransport_complete
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    (sfCbcSite X).IsComplete _ (sfCbcModelIdeal (constantDatum l E))
      ((H l E X).obj K.obj)

mathlib_searches.query: restriction of scalars along adic completion is fully faithful on derived complete modules
mathlib_searches.results: Eight algebraic adic-completion results, including AdicCompletion.of_bijective and AdicCompletion.module; none for derived module sheaves or the fixed functor H.

mathlib_searches.query: A fully faithful functor gives a unique lift of a morphism between its images
mathlib_searches.results: Functor.FullyFaithful.preimage, map_preimage, map_injective and generic full-functor results. These supply the categorical Hom API, but do not establish full faithfulness of H.

Twenty-five Mathlib hits on generic fully faithful functors and algebraic completion. Local rg found ConstantCompletion.equivalence and sfCbcModelModules_derived, but no identification with the IsSfDerivedComplete locus and H.map.
